_doc: Kho điểm ngữ pháp tiếng Pháp (Pháp chuẩn, trung tính) của LexKite. 100% tự soạn: tên điểm, câu "Can …" và ví dụ là của LexKite, không chép Référentiels (CECRL/DELF) hay sách giáo trình (CONTENT-RULES §1). lessons = id bài fr (chưa có → []); tenses = khóa của scripts/target/conjugate.mjs; kiểm: node scripts/content-qa/grammar-map-check.mjs --tl fr; id điểm KHÔNG đổi/tái dùng.

points.name: être: present tense
points.can_do_en: Can use être to say who I am, where I am from and what I am like.
points.example: Je suis Léa et je suis étudiante. Nous sommes de Lyon.
points.example_en: I'm Léa and I'm a student. We're from Lyon.

points.name: avoir: present tense
points.can_do_en: Can use avoir to say what I have, my age and my family.
points.example: J'ai deux frères. Elle a un chat.
points.example_en: I have two brothers. She has a cat.

points.name: il y a: there is, there are
points.can_do_en: Can say that something exists or is in a place with il y a.
points.example: Il y a un café près de la gare.
points.example_en: There is a café near the station.

points.name: Definite articles: le, la, l', les
points.can_do_en: Can use le, la and les to talk about specific or general things.
points.example: Le café est chaud. Les enfants jouent dans la rue.
points.example_en: The coffee is hot. The children are playing in the street.

points.name: Indefinite articles: un, une, des
points.can_do_en: Can use un, une and des to introduce people and things.
points.example: Il y a un livre et des stylos sur la table.
points.example_en: There is a book and some pens on the table.

points.name: Gender of nouns
points.can_do_en: Can guess whether a noun is masculine or feminine from its ending.
points.example: Le village est petit et la ville est grande.
points.example_en: The village is small and the town is big.

points.name: Regular plurals
points.can_do_en: Can form the plural of most nouns by adding -s.
points.example: J'ai deux sœurs et trois amis.
points.example_en: I have two sisters and three friends.

points.name: Irregular plurals: -aux, -eaux, -eux
points.can_do_en: Can form common irregular plurals like journaux, bateaux and cheveux.
points.example: Les journaux sont sur les tables.
points.example_en: The newspapers are on the tables.

points.name: Elision: l', j', n', qu'
points.can_do_en: Can write the elided forms l', j', n', d' and qu' before a vowel sound.
points.example: J'aime l'école, mais je n'aime pas l'hiver.
points.example_en: I like school, but I don't like winter.

points.name: Contractions: au, aux, du, des
points.can_do_en: Can combine à and de with le and les correctly.
points.example: Je vais au marché et je parle aux voisins.
points.example_en: I'm going to the market and I talk to the neighbours.

points.name: Partitive articles: du, de la, des
points.can_do_en: Can talk about an unspecified amount with du, de la and des.
points.example: Je mange du pain et je bois de l'eau.
points.example_en: I eat bread and I drink water.

points.name: de after negation
points.can_do_en: Can replace du, de la, des and un with de after a negative.
points.example: Je n'ai pas de voiture. Il ne mange jamais de viande.
points.example_en: I don't have a car. He never eats meat.

points.name: Adjective agreement
points.can_do_en: Can make an adjective agree in gender and number with the noun.
points.example: Ma sœur est grande et mes frères sont petits.
points.example_en: My sister is tall and my brothers are short.

points.name: Adjective position
points.can_do_en: Can place common short adjectives before the noun and most others after it.
points.example: C'est une belle maison blanche.
points.example_en: It's a beautiful white house.

points.name: Possessive adjectives
points.can_do_en: Can use mon, ma, mes, ton, son, notre, leur to say who something belongs to.
points.example: Mon père et ma mère habitent avec leurs chats.
points.example_en: My father and mother live with their cats.

points.name: Demonstratives: ce, cet, cette, ces
points.can_do_en: Can point to things with ce, cet, cette and ces.
points.example: Ce livre est cher, mais cette veste est belle.
points.example_en: This book is expensive, but this jacket is nice.

points.name: Présent of -er verbs
points.can_do_en: Can conjugate regular -er verbs in the present.
points.example: Je parle français et tu habites à Paris.
points.example_en: I speak French and you live in Paris.

points.name: Présent of -ir and -re verbs
points.can_do_en: Can conjugate regular -ir (finir) and -re (vendre) verbs.
points.example: Elle finit ses devoirs et il vend sa voiture.
points.example_en: She finishes her homework and he sells his car.

points.name: Présent of aller, faire, prendre, venir
points.can_do_en: Can use the present of the most common irregular verbs.
points.example: Je vais au marché et je fais les courses.
points.example_en: I'm going to the market and I'm doing the shopping.

points.name: tu or vous?
points.can_do_en: Can choose between tu and vous depending on who I am talking to.
points.example: Tu viens, Paul ? Vous venez, madame ?
points.example_en: Are you coming, Paul? Are you coming, madam?

points.name: on: we, one, people
points.can_do_en: Can use on to mean we or people in general.
points.example: On mange ensemble ce soir ? Nous allons au parc.
points.example_en: Shall we eat together tonight? We're going to the park.

points.name: Negation: ne … pas
points.can_do_en: Can make a sentence negative with ne … pas.
points.example: Je ne parle pas allemand. Il n'aime pas le thé.
points.example_en: I don't speak German. He doesn't like tea.

points.name: Yes/no questions: intonation and est-ce que
points.can_do_en: Can ask a yes/no question with rising intonation or est-ce que.
points.example: Tu aimes le thé ? Est-ce que vous avez des enfants ?
points.example_en: Do you like tea? Do you have children?

points.name: Question words: où, quand, comment, combien, pourquoi
points.can_do_en: Can ask for place, time, manner, quantity and reason.
points.example: Où habites-tu ? Combien ça coûte ?
points.example_en: Where do you live? How much does it cost?

points.name: quel, quelle, quels, quelles
points.can_do_en: Can ask 'which' or 'what' with quel and agree it with the noun.
points.example: Quelle heure est-il ? Quels films aimes-tu ?
points.example_en: What time is it? Which films do you like?

points.name: Futur proche: aller + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can talk about near-future plans with aller + infinitive.
points.example: Je vais manger. Elle va partir demain.
points.example_en: I'm going to eat. She's going to leave tomorrow.

points.name: Pronominal verbs (se lever, se coucher)
points.can_do_en: Can use reflexive verbs to talk about my daily routine.
points.example: Je me lève à sept heures. Elle se couche tard.
points.example_en: I get up at seven. She goes to bed late.

points.name: Imperative: orders and requests
points.can_do_en: Can give simple orders and suggestions with the imperative.
points.example: Écoute, regarde et répète !
points.example_en: Listen, look and repeat!

points.name: vouloir, pouvoir, devoir + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can say what I want, can and must do with vouloir, pouvoir and devoir.
points.example: Je veux partir. Tu peux m'aider ? Nous devons travailler.
points.example_en: I want to leave. Can you help me? We have to work.

points.name: Prepositions of place
points.can_do_en: Can say where something is with dans, sur, sous, devant, derrière, entre.
points.example: Le chat est sous la table, à côté du canapé.
points.example_en: The cat is under the table, next to the sofa.

points.name: à, chez, de: going to and coming from
points.can_do_en: Can say where I go and where I come from with à, chez and de.
points.example: Je vais chez Marie et je viens de la gare.
points.example_en: I'm going to Marie's and I'm coming from the station.

points.name: Numbers 0–100 and prices
points.can_do_en: Can use numbers up to 100 for ages, prices and quantities.
points.example: J'ai vingt et un ans. Ça coûte soixante-dix euros.
points.example_en: I'm twenty-one. It costs seventy euros.

points.name: Telling the time and dates
points.can_do_en: Can say the time and the date.
points.example: Il est huit heures et demie. Nous sommes le cinq mai.
points.example_en: It's half past eight. It's the fifth of May.

points.name: C'est / ce sont
points.can_do_en: Can introduce and identify people and things with c'est and ce sont.
points.example: C'est mon frère. Ce sont mes amis.
points.example_en: This is my brother. These are my friends.

points.name: Likes and dislikes: aimer, adorer, détester
points.can_do_en: Can say what I like or dislike with aimer, adorer and détester.
points.example: J'aime le chocolat et je déteste les épinards.
points.example_en: I like chocolate and I hate spinach.

points.name: très, beaucoup, un peu, trop
points.can_do_en: Can say how much with très, beaucoup, un peu and trop.
points.example: Il est très grand et il mange beaucoup.
points.example_en: He is very tall and he eats a lot.

points.name: avoir expressions: faim, soif, ans, peur
points.can_do_en: Can use avoir to say age, hunger, thirst and feelings of cold or fear.
points.example: J'ai faim et j'ai vingt ans.
points.example_en: I'm hungry and I'm twenty.

points.name: et, ou, mais, parce que
points.can_do_en: Can link two ideas with et, ou, mais and parce que.
points.example: Je suis fatigué, mais je travaille parce que j'ai un examen.
points.example_en: I'm tired, but I'm working because I have an exam.

points.name: Passé composé with avoir
points.can_do_en: Can talk about finished actions with avoir + past participle.
points.example: J'ai mangé une pomme. Nous avons fini le travail.
points.example_en: I ate an apple. We finished the work.

points.name: Passé composé with être
points.can_do_en: Can use être as the auxiliary with verbs of movement and change of state.
points.example: Je suis allé au cinéma. Elle est partie à six heures.
points.example_en: I went to the cinema. She left at six.

points.name: Agreement of the participle with être
points.can_do_en: Can make the past participle agree with the subject after être.
points.example: Marie est partie. Mes amis sont venus.
points.example_en: Marie left. My friends came.

points.name: Passé composé of pronominal verbs
points.can_do_en: Can use pronominal verbs in the passé composé with être.
points.example: Elle s'est levée tôt. Nous nous sommes promenés.
points.example_en: She got up early. We went for a walk.

points.name: Negation in the passé composé
points.can_do_en: Can make a passé composé sentence negative.
points.example: Je n'ai pas mangé. Il n'est jamais venu.
points.example_en: I didn't eat. He never came.

points.name: Irregular past participles
points.can_do_en: Can use common irregular past participles like eu, été, fait, pris, vu.
points.example: Hier, j'ai vu un film et nous avons fait du sport.
points.example_en: Yesterday I watched a film and we did sport.

points.name: Imparfait: formation
points.can_do_en: Can form the imparfait from the nous stem.
points.example: Je jouais au parc. Nous allions chez nos grands-parents.
points.example_en: I used to play in the park. We used to go to our grandparents'.

points.name: Imparfait: habits and descriptions
points.can_do_en: Can describe the past scene, habits and states with the imparfait.
points.example: Quand j'étais petit, je jouais dehors. Il faisait beau.
points.example_en: When I was little, I played outside. The weather was nice.

points.name: Imparfait vs passé composé
points.can_do_en: Can combine the imparfait for background and the passé composé for events.
points.example: Je dormais quand le téléphone a sonné.
points.example_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

points.name: Futur simple
points.can_do_en: Can talk about the future with the futur simple.
points.example: Demain, je serai à Paris. Nous prendrons le train.
points.example_en: Tomorrow I'll be in Paris. We'll take the train.

points.name: Irregular futur stems
points.can_do_en: Can use the irregular stems of common verbs in the futur simple.
points.example: Il fera beau demain. Nous irons en vacances.
points.example_en: The weather will be nice tomorrow. We'll go on holiday.

points.name: Conditionnel: polite requests
points.can_do_en: Can make polite requests and offers with je voudrais and pourriez-vous.
points.example: Je voudrais un café. Pourriez-vous m'aider ?
points.example_en: I would like a coffee. Could you help me?

points.name: Direct object pronouns: le, la, les
points.can_do_en: Can replace a direct object with le, la, l' or les.
points.example: Je le vois. Elle les achète.
points.example_en: I see him. She buys them.

points.name: Indirect object pronouns: lui, leur
points.can_do_en: Can replace a person introduced by à with lui or leur.
points.example: Je lui parle. Elle leur écrit.
points.example_en: I talk to him. She writes to them.

points.name: me, te, nous, vous as object pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can use me, te, nous and vous as object pronouns.
points.example: Il me voit. Elle nous parle.
points.example_en: He sees me. She speaks to us.

points.name: The pronoun y
points.can_do_en: Can replace a place or a phrase with à with y.
points.example: Tu vas à Paris ? Oui, j'y vais.
points.example_en: Are you going to Paris? Yes, I'm going there.

points.name: The pronoun en
points.can_do_en: Can replace du, de la, des and quantities with en.
points.example: Tu veux du pain ? Oui, j'en veux.
points.example_en: Do you want some bread? Yes, I want some.

points.name: Stressed pronouns: moi, toi, lui, eux
points.can_do_en: Can use moi, toi, lui, elle, nous, vous, eux, elles after prepositions and alone.
points.example: Tu viens avec moi ? Moi, j'aime le café.
points.example_en: Are you coming with me? As for me, I like coffee.

points.name: Comparatives: plus, moins, aussi … que
points.can_do_en: Can compare two things with plus, moins or aussi … que.
points.example: Paul est plus grand que Marc.
points.example_en: Paul is taller than Marc.

points.name: Superlatives: le plus, la moins
points.can_do_en: Can say the most or the least with le plus, la plus, les moins.
points.example: C'est le plus grand musée de Paris.
points.example_en: It's the biggest museum in Paris.

points.name: meilleur vs mieux
points.can_do_en: Can use meilleur for adjectives and mieux for verbs.
points.example: Ce gâteau est meilleur. Elle chante mieux.
points.example_en: This cake is better. She sings better.

points.name: Adverbs in -ment
points.can_do_en: Can form adverbs from adjectives with -ment.
points.example: Elle parle lentement. Il conduit prudemment.
points.example_en: She speaks slowly. He drives carefully.

points.name: Prepositions with countries and cities
points.can_do_en: Can say I live in, go to and come from a city or country.
points.example: J'habite en France et je vais au Japon. Il travaille à Paris.
points.example_en: I live in France and I'm going to Japan. He works in Paris.

points.name: depuis, pendant, il y a
points.can_do_en: Can express duration and time ago with depuis, pendant and il y a.
points.example: J'habite ici depuis deux ans. Il est parti il y a une heure.
points.example_en: I've lived here for two years. He left an hour ago.

points.name: Passé récent: venir de + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can say something has just happened with venir de + infinitive.
points.example: Je viens de manger. Ils viennent de partir.
points.example_en: I've just eaten. They've just left.

points.name: Negative imperative
points.can_do_en: Can tell someone not to do something with ne … pas.
points.example: Ne parle pas ! Ne prenez pas de photos.
points.example_en: Don't talk! Don't take photos.

points.name: Imperative with pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can use object pronouns with the affirmative imperative.
points.example: Regarde-moi ! Dis-lui la vérité.
points.example_en: Look at me! Tell him the truth.

points.name: Relative pronouns: qui and que
points.can_do_en: Can link two clauses with qui (subject) and que (object).
points.example: L'homme qui parle est mon père. Le livre que je lis est bon.
points.example_en: The man who is talking is my father. The book I'm reading is good.

points.name: Relative pronoun où
points.can_do_en: Can say where or when with où.
points.example: Le jour où je suis arrivé, il pleuvait.
points.example_en: The day I arrived, it was raining.

points.name: il faut + infinitive or noun
points.can_do_en: Can say what is necessary with il faut.
points.example: Il faut travailler. Il faut du temps.
points.example_en: One has to work. It takes time.

points.name: Negation: jamais, plus, rien, personne
points.can_do_en: Can say never, no more, nothing and nobody.
points.example: Je ne vois personne. Il ne mange rien.
points.example_en: I don't see anybody. He eats nothing.

points.name: Quantity words + de
points.can_do_en: Can say how much with beaucoup de, un peu de, trop de, assez de.
points.example: J'ai beaucoup de travail et un peu de temps.
points.example_en: I have a lot of work and a little time.

points.name: c'est vs il est
points.can_do_en: Can choose between c'est and il est/elle est to describe people and things.
points.example: C'est un médecin. Il est médecin.
points.example_en: He is a doctor. He is a doctor.

points.name: Questions with inversion
points.can_do_en: Can ask formal questions by inverting verb and subject.
points.example: Où habites-tu ? Parlez-vous anglais ?
points.example_en: Where do you live? Do you speak English?

points.name: qui, que, quoi, qu'est-ce que
points.can_do_en: Can ask who and what with qui, que, quoi and qu'est-ce que.
points.example: Qui est-ce ? Qu'est-ce que tu fais ?
points.example_en: Who is it? What are you doing?

points.name: Irregular adjectives: beau, nouveau, vieux
points.can_do_en: Can use beau, nouveau and vieux and their feminine and vowel forms.
points.example: C'est un bel homme avec une nouvelle voiture.
points.example_en: He is a handsome man with a new car.

points.name: Sequencing: d'abord, ensuite, puis, enfin
points.can_do_en: Can tell the order of actions with d'abord, ensuite, puis and enfin.
points.example: D'abord, je me lève ; ensuite, je prends une douche.
points.example_en: First, I get up; then I take a shower.

points.name: si + présent, futur
points.can_do_en: Can say what will happen if something happens with si + présent, futur.
points.example: Si tu viens, nous mangerons ensemble.
points.example_en: If you come, we'll eat together.

points.name: savoir vs connaître
points.can_do_en: Can choose between savoir (facts, skills) and connaître (people, places).
points.example: Je sais nager. Je connais Paris.
points.example_en: I can swim. I know Paris.

points.name: Présent of lire, dire, écrire, voir, boire
points.can_do_en: Can use the present of common irregular verbs like lire, dire, écrire.
points.example: Nous lisons un livre et vous écrivez une lettre.
points.example_en: We read a book and you write a letter.

points.name: Weather expressions with il
points.can_do_en: Can talk about the weather with il fait, il pleut, il neige.
points.example: Il fait beau. Il pleut depuis ce matin.
points.example_en: The weather is nice. It has been raining since this morning.

points.name: Professions without an article
points.can_do_en: Can say what someone does without an article after être.
points.example: Elle est infirmière. Mon père est professeur.
points.example_en: She is a nurse. My father is a teacher.

points.name: Subjunctive after il faut que
points.can_do_en: Can use the present subjunctive after il faut que.
points.example: Il faut que tu viennes. Il faut que je parte.
points.example_en: You have to come. I have to leave.

points.name: Subjunctive after vouloir que
points.can_do_en: Can say I want someone to do something with vouloir que + subjunctive.
points.example: Je veux que tu viennes. Elle veut que nous partions.
points.example_en: I want you to come. She wants us to leave.

points.name: Irregular subjunctive: être, avoir, aller, faire
points.can_do_en: Can use the irregular subjunctive forms of être, avoir, aller, faire, pouvoir, savoir.
points.example: Il faut que tu sois patient et que nous fassions attention.
points.example_en: You have to be patient and we have to be careful.

points.name: Subjunctive after feelings
points.can_do_en: Can express feelings about a fact with être content que, regretter que, avoir peur que.
points.example: Je suis content que tu sois là.
points.example_en: I'm glad you are here.

points.name: Subjunctive or indicative?
points.can_do_en: Can choose between indicative (certainty) and subjunctive (doubt, will, feeling).
points.example: Je pense qu'il a raison. Je ne pense pas qu'il ait raison.
points.example_en: I think he is right. I don't think he is right.

points.name: Conjunctions with the subjunctive
points.can_do_en: Can use pour que, avant que, bien que, à condition que with the subjunctive.
points.example: Bien qu'il soit fatigué, il travaille.
points.example_en: Although he is tired, he is working.

points.name: si + imparfait, conditionnel
points.can_do_en: Can talk about unreal or unlikely situations with si + imparfait, conditionnel.
points.example: Si j'avais de l'argent, j'achèterais une maison.
points.example_en: If I had money, I would buy a house.

points.name: Conditionnel: advice, wishes, possibilities
points.can_do_en: Can give advice and express wishes with the conditionnel.
points.example: Tu devrais dormir. Nous aimerions voyager.
points.example_en: You should sleep. We would like to travel.

points.name: si + plus-que-parfait, conditionnel passé
points.can_do_en: Can express regret about the past with si + plus-que-parfait, conditionnel passé.
points.example: Si j'avais su, je serais venu.
points.example_en: If I had known, I would have come.

points.name: Plus-que-parfait: formation
points.can_do_en: Can form the plus-que-parfait with avoir or être in the imparfait + participle.
points.example: Elle avait fini. Nous étions partis.
points.example_en: She had finished. We had left.

points.name: Plus-que-parfait: earlier past action
points.can_do_en: Can say that one past action happened before another with the plus-que-parfait.
points.example: Quand je suis arrivé, le film avait déjà commencé.
points.example_en: When I arrived, the film had already started.

points.name: Reported speech in the present
points.can_do_en: Can report what someone says with dire que and a present-tense introduction.
points.example: Il dit qu'il est fatigué. Elle répond qu'elle ne sait pas.
points.example_en: He says he is tired. She answers that she doesn't know.

points.name: Reported questions: si, ce que, où
points.can_do_en: Can report a question with demander si, où, quand, ce que.
points.example: Il demande si je viens. Elle demande où j'habite.
points.example_en: He asks if I'm coming. She asks where I live.

points.name: Reported speech in the past
points.can_do_en: Can report speech after a past verb by shifting the tenses.
points.example: Il a dit qu'il était fatigué.
points.example_en: He said he was tired.

points.name: Gérondif: formation
points.can_do_en: Can form the gérondif with en + present participle.
points.example: Il chante en travaillant. Elle mange en lisant.
points.example_en: He sings while working. She eats while reading.

points.name: Gérondif: at the same time, how, if
points.can_do_en: Can use the gérondif to say simultaneity, manner or condition.
points.example: On apprend en lisant. Il s'est blessé en jouant au football.
points.example_en: You learn by reading. He hurt himself playing football.

points.name: Relative pronoun dont
points.can_do_en: Can use dont to replace a phrase with de.
points.example: Voici le livre dont je t'ai parlé.
points.example_en: Here is the book I told you about.

points.name: ce qui, ce que, ce dont
points.can_do_en: Can say what with ce qui, ce que and ce dont.
points.example: Dis-moi ce que tu veux. Je ne comprends pas ce qui se passe.
points.example_en: Tell me what you want. I don't understand what is happening.

points.name: Order of two object pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can combine two pronouns such as le lui, me le, nous les.
points.example: Je le lui donne. Elle me les envoie.
points.example_en: I give it to him. She sends them to me.

points.name: il y en a, y and en together
points.can_do_en: Can use y and en together and in il y en a.
points.example: Des pommes ? Il y en a dans le panier.
points.example_en: Apples? There are some in the basket.

points.name: Imperative: order of pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can order two pronouns after an affirmative imperative.
points.example: Donne-le-moi ! Dis-le-lui.
points.example_en: Give it to me! Tell it to him.

points.name: Possessive pronouns: le mien, la tienne
points.can_do_en: Can use le mien, la tienne, les nôtres to avoid repeating a noun.
points.example: Ce n'est pas ton stylo, c'est le mien.
points.example_en: That is not your pen, it's mine.

points.name: Demonstrative pronouns: celui, celle, ceux, celles
points.can_do_en: Can use celui, celle, ceux, celles to choose between things.
points.example: Quel stylo ? Celui de gauche.
points.example_en: Which pen? The one on the left.

points.name: Indefinite pronouns: quelqu'un, quelque chose, chacun
points.can_do_en: Can use quelqu'un, quelque chose, chacun, plusieurs in simple sentences.
points.example: Il y a quelqu'un à la porte. Je voudrais quelque chose de sucré.
points.example_en: There is someone at the door. I'd like something sweet.

points.name: Indefinite adjectives: chaque, plusieurs, quelques, tout
points.can_do_en: Can use chaque, plusieurs, quelques and tout with nouns.
points.example: Chaque élève a un livre. Il y a plusieurs voitures.
points.example_en: Every pupil has a book. There are several cars.

points.name: Participle agreement with a preceding direct object
points.can_do_en: Can make the participle agree with a direct object that comes before avoir.
points.example: Les fleurs que j'ai achetées sont belles.
points.example_en: The flowers I bought are beautiful.

points.name: Passive voice: être + participle
points.can_do_en: Can form and use the passive with être + past participle + par.
points.example: Ce roman est écrit par un auteur célèbre.
points.example_en: This novel is written by a famous author.

points.name: se + verb: reflexive passive
points.can_do_en: Can say how things are normally done with ça se fait, ça se dit, ça se vend.
points.example: Ce produit se vend partout. Ça ne se dit pas.
points.example_en: This product is sold everywhere. You don't say that.

points.name: être en train de + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can say that something is happening right now with être en train de.
points.example: Je suis en train de manger.
points.example_en: I'm in the middle of eating.

points.name: sortir, monter, passer with avoir
points.can_do_en: Can choose avoir for sortir, monter, descendre, passer, rentrer when they have an object.
points.example: Il a sorti la valise. Elle est sortie.
points.example_en: He took out the suitcase. She went out.

points.name: Futur antérieur
points.can_do_en: Can say that something will be finished before another future event.
points.example: Quand j'aurai fini, je t'appellerai.
points.example_en: When I've finished, I'll call you.

points.name: quand, dès que + futur
points.can_do_en: Can use the future after quand, dès que and lorsque for future events.
points.example: Quand je serai grand, je deviendrai pilote.
points.example_en: When I grow up, I'll become a pilot.

points.name: Cause and consequence: car, donc, comme, puisque
points.can_do_en: Can give reasons and results with car, donc, comme, puisque.
points.example: Il pleut, donc nous restons à la maison.
points.example_en: It's raining, so we are staying at home.

points.name: Contrast: pourtant, cependant, alors que, malgré
points.can_do_en: Can contrast ideas with pourtant, cependant, alors que and malgré.
points.example: Il est riche, pourtant il n'est pas heureux.
points.example_en: He is rich, yet he isn't happy.

points.name: Purpose: pour, afin de, pour que
points.can_do_en: Can say why with pour + infinitive, afin de and pour que + subjunctive.
points.example: Je travaille pour gagner de l'argent.
points.example_en: I work to earn money.

points.name: ne … que, ne … ni … ni, ne … aucun
points.can_do_en: Can say only, neither … nor and not any.
points.example: Je n'ai que dix euros. Elle ne mange ni viande ni poisson.
points.example_en: I only have ten euros. She eats neither meat nor fish.

points.name: Negation with an infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can put ne pas, ne plus, ne jamais before an infinitive.
points.example: Il m'a demandé de ne pas fumer ici.
points.example_en: He asked me not to smoke here.

points.name: lequel, laquelle, lesquels, lesquelles
points.can_do_en: Can ask which one with lequel and its forms.
points.example: Tu as deux sacs : lequel préfères-tu ?
points.example_en: You have two bags: which one do you prefer?

points.name: Exclamations: quel, comme, que
points.can_do_en: Can make an exclamation with quel, comme and que.
points.example: Quelle belle journée ! Comme il fait chaud !
points.example_en: What a lovely day! How hot it is!

points.name: Adverb position in the passé composé
points.can_do_en: Can place déjà, bien, souvent between the auxiliary and the participle.
points.example: Elle a déjà fini. Nous sommes souvent allés au Maroc.
points.example_en: She has already finished. We often went to Morocco.

points.name: de plus en plus, plus … plus, autant de
points.can_do_en: Can express gradual change and proportion with de plus en plus, plus … plus, autant de.
points.example: Il fait de plus en plus froid. Plus on travaille, plus on apprend.
points.example_en: It's getting colder and colder. The more you work, the more you learn.

points.name: Verbs with à and de
points.can_do_en: Can use common verbs followed by à or de: penser à, parler de, avoir besoin de.
points.example: Je pense à mes vacances. Nous avons besoin d'aide.
points.example_en: I'm thinking about my holidays. We need help.

points.name: en vs dans with time
points.can_do_en: Can tell en (duration) from dans (a point in the future).
points.example: Le film commence dans une heure. Il a lu ce livre en deux jours.
points.example_en: The film starts in an hour. He read this book in two days.

points.name: Infinitive after avant de, après, sans
points.can_do_en: Can use avant de, après avoir and sans + infinitive.
points.example: Lave-toi les mains avant de manger. Après avoir mangé, nous sortons.
points.example_en: Wash your hands before eating. After eating, we go out.

points.name: faire + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can say that someone has something done or makes someone do something with faire + infinitive.
points.example: Je fais réparer ma voiture. Il fait rire les enfants.
points.example_en: I'm having my car repaired. He makes the children laugh.

points.name: Verbs of perception + infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can use voir, entendre, regarder + infinitive to say what I see or hear.
points.example: Je les entends chanter. Nous voyons passer le train.
points.example_en: I hear them singing. We see the train go by.

points.name: Written forms before a vowel: mon amie, cet homme, bel
points.can_do_en: Can write mon, cet, bel, nouvel before a vowel sound.
points.example: Mon amie habite dans un bel immeuble.
points.example_en: My friend lives in a beautiful building.

points.name: tout, tous, toute, toutes
points.can_do_en: Can use tout, tous, toute, toutes correctly as adjective, pronoun and adverb.
points.example: Les enfants sont tous là. Elle a tout compris.
points.example_en: The children are all here. She understood everything.

points.name: subjunctive after bien que and concession conjunctions
points.can_do_en: Can express concession with bien que, quoique and encore que followed by the subjunctive.
points.example: Bien que le projet soit coûteux, nous allons le poursuivre.
points.example_en: Although the project is expensive, we are going to continue it.

points.name: subjunctive after pour que and afin que
points.can_do_en: Can state a purpose with pour que or afin que and the subjunctive.
points.example: Je vous écris afin que vous puissiez réserver à temps.
points.example_en: I am writing to you so that you can book in time.

points.name: subjunctive after avant que and jusqu'à ce que
points.can_do_en: Can use avant que and jusqu'à ce que with the subjunctive for time limits.
points.example: Rangez vos affaires avant que le cours ne commence.
points.example_en: Put your things away before the class begins.

points.name: à moins que with the subjunctive
points.can_do_en: Can state an exception with à moins que and the subjunctive.
points.example: Nous partirons demain, à moins qu'il ne pleuve.
points.example_en: We will leave tomorrow, unless it rains.

points.name: à condition que and pourvu que
points.can_do_en: Can set a condition with à condition que or pourvu que and the subjunctive.
points.example: Je viendrai, à condition que vous me préveniez.
points.example_en: I will come, provided that you let me know.

points.name: subjunctive or indicative after opinion verbs
points.can_do_en: Can choose between indicative and subjunctive after penser que, croire que and their negative or question forms.
points.example: Je pense qu'il viendra, mais je ne pense pas qu'il soit prêt.
points.example_en: I think he will come, but I do not think he is ready.

points.name: subjunctive after emotion, doubt and necessity
points.can_do_en: Can use the subjunctive after verbs of feeling, doubt and necessity.
points.example: Je suis ravie que vous veniez, mais je doute qu'il puisse venir.
points.example_en: I'm delighted that you are coming, but I doubt he can come.

points.name: irregular subjunctive stems
points.can_do_en: Can form the subjunctive of être, avoir, aller, faire, pouvoir, savoir and vouloir.
points.example: Il est possible qu'elle sache la réponse et qu'elle aille la donner.
points.example_en: It is possible that she knows the answer and goes to give it.

points.name: past subjunctive
points.can_do_en: Can use the past subjunctive for an action completed before another.
points.example: Je suis content que vous soyez arrivés avant la fin.
points.example_en: I am glad that you arrived before the end.

points.name: subjunctive or infinitive with the same subject
points.can_do_en: Can use an infinitive when the subject is shared and the subjunctive when it changes.
points.example: Je veux partir, mais je veux que tu restes.
points.example_en: I want to leave, but I want you to stay.

points.name: subjunctive in relative clauses after superlatives
points.can_do_en: Can use the subjunctive in a relative clause after a superlative or seul, premier, dernier.
points.example: C'est le meilleur roman que j'aie jamais lu.
points.example_en: It is the best novel I have ever read.

points.name: subjunctive after a wished-for or unknown antecedent
points.can_do_en: Can use the subjunctive in a relative clause describing something sought but not known to exist.
points.example: Je cherche un appartement qui soit calme et lumineux.
points.example_en: I am looking for a flat that is quiet and bright.

points.name: conditional for unconfirmed information
points.can_do_en: Can report unverified facts in the news with the conditional.
points.example: Le ministre aurait démissionné hier soir, selon la presse.
points.example_en: The minister reportedly resigned last night, according to the press.

points.name: si with the pluperfect and past conditional
points.can_do_en: Can express unreal past conditions with si plus-que-parfait and conditionnel passé.
points.example: Si j'avais su, je serais venu plus tôt.
points.example_en: If I had known, I would have come earlier.

points.name: mixed conditional sentences
points.can_do_en: Can combine a past condition with a present result.
points.example: Si tu avais écouté, tu comprendrais maintenant.
points.example_en: If you had listened, you would understand now.

points.name: hypothesis without si
points.can_do_en: Can express a precaution with au cas où and the conditional.
points.example: Prenez un parapluie au cas où il pleuvrait.
points.example_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

points.name: après que with the indicative
points.can_do_en: Can use après que and dès que with the indicative and correct tense sequence.
points.example: Après qu'il a fini son travail, il est rentré.
points.example_en: After he finished his work, he went home.

points.name: sequence of tenses
points.can_do_en: Can keep tenses consistent between a main clause and a subordinate clause.
points.example: Il pensait que nous étions déjà partis.
points.example_en: He thought that we had already left.

points.name: reported speech in the past
points.can_do_en: Can report statements in the past, shifting tenses and time words.
points.example: Elle a dit qu'elle viendrait le lendemain.
points.example_en: She said she would come the next day.

points.name: reported questions
points.can_do_en: Can report questions with si, ce qui, ce que and indirect word order.
points.example: Il m'a demandé ce que je voulais faire le soir.
points.example_en: He asked me what I wanted to do in the evening.

points.name: reported commands and requests
points.can_do_en: Can report orders and requests with dire de and demander de plus an infinitive.
points.example: La directrice nous a demandé de relire le rapport.
points.example_en: The manager asked us to reread the report.

points.name: agreement of the past participle with a preceding direct object
points.can_do_en: Can agree the participle with avoir when the direct object comes before it.
points.example: Les photos que j'ai prises sont très réussies.
points.example_en: The photos I took are very successful.

points.name: agreement of the past participle in pronominal verbs
points.can_do_en: Can agree the participle of pronominal verbs and spot cases with no agreement.
points.example: Elle s'est lavé les mains, puis elle s'est maquillée.
points.example_en: She washed her hands, then put on her make-up.

points.name: present participle, gerund and verbal adjective
points.can_do_en: Can tell apart the present participle, the gerund and the adjective verbal.
points.example: En marchant vers la gare, j'ai croisé un homme souriant.
points.example_en: While walking to the station, I passed a smiling man.

points.name: passive voice and its alternatives
points.can_do_en: Can use the passive and alternatives such as on, a reflexive or se faire.
points.example: Cette pièce se joue encore, et elle est applaudie partout.
points.example_en: This play is still performed, and it is applauded everywhere.

points.name: causative faire and laisser with an infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can use faire and laisser followed by an infinitive for causation and permission.
points.example: Elle fait réparer sa voiture et nous laisse entrer.
points.example_en: She has her car repaired and lets us in.

points.name: compound relative pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can use lequel, auquel, duquel and prepositions with relative pronouns.
points.example: Voici le projet auquel nous avons beaucoup travaillé.
points.example_en: Here is the project we worked on a lot.

points.name: relative pronoun dont
points.can_do_en: Can use dont to replace de plus a noun in a relative clause.
points.example: Le livre dont tu parles est en rupture de stock.
points.example_en: The book you are talking about is out of stock.

points.name: ce qui, ce que, ce dont, ce à quoi
points.can_do_en: Can use indefinite relatives for ideas and unnamed things.
points.example: Je ne comprends pas ce dont tu as besoin.
points.example_en: I do not understand what you need.

points.name: order of double object pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can order two pronouns before a verb and after an affirmative imperative.
points.example: Je le lui donne, donne-le-moi ensuite.
points.example_en: I am giving it to him, then give it to me.

points.name: advanced use of y and en
points.can_do_en: Can use y and en with quantities, infinitives and combined pronouns.
points.example: Il y en a trois, mais je ne m'en souviens plus.
points.example_en: There are three of them, but I no longer remember.

points.name: emphasis with c'est ... qui/que
points.can_do_en: Can stress an element with c'est ... qui or c'est ... que.
points.example: C'est la direction qui décidera, et non pas nous.
points.example_en: It is the management that will decide, not us.

points.name: inversion after peut-être, aussi and sans doute
points.can_do_en: Can invert the subject after sentence adverbs in formal writing.
points.example: Peut-être viendra-t-il demain, sans doute aurons-nous des nouvelles.
points.example_en: Perhaps he will come tomorrow; we will probably have news.

points.name: expletive ne
points.can_do_en: Can recognise and use ne explétif after craindre, avant que and comparatives.
points.example: Je crains qu'il ne soit trop tard.
points.example_en: I am afraid it may be too late.

points.name: connectors of concession and opposition
points.can_do_en: Can use pourtant, cependant, en revanche, malgré and alors que.
points.example: Ce film est long ; pourtant, nous ne nous sommes pas ennuyés.
points.example_en: This film is long; yet we were not bored.

points.name: nominalisation
points.can_do_en: Can turn verbs and adjectives into nouns to write more concisely.
points.example: La réduction des coûts permet l'amélioration du service.
points.example_en: Reducing costs allows the service to improve.

points.name: tout as adjective, pronoun and adverb
points.can_do_en: Can handle the agreement of tout and toute.
points.example: Elle est tout étonnée, et toutes les fenêtres sont ouvertes.
points.example_en: She is quite astonished, and all the windows are open.

points.name: prepositions after verbs
points.can_do_en: Can choose between penser à and penser de, and other verb plus preposition pairs.
points.example: Que pensez-vous de cette idée, et à quoi pensez-vous ?
points.example_en: What do you think of this idea, and what are you thinking about?

points.name: past infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can use après avoir or après être with the past participle.
points.example: Après avoir fini ses études, elle est partie à Lyon.
points.example_en: After finishing her studies, she left for Lyon.

points.name: interrogative lequel
points.can_do_en: Can ask for a choice with lequel, laquelle, auquel and duquel.
points.example: Lequel de ces itinéraires conseillez-vous ?
points.example_en: Which of these routes do you recommend?

points.name: recognising the imperfect subjunctive
points.can_do_en: Can recognise the imperfect subjunctive in formal and literary texts.
points.example: Il fallait qu'elle partît avant que la nuit ne tombât.
points.example_en: She had to leave before night fell.

points.name: tense sequence of the subjunctive
points.can_do_en: Can choose between present and past subjunctive according to timing.
points.example: Je doute qu'il ait compris, et je regrette qu'il soit parti.
points.example_en: I doubt that he understood, and I regret that he left.

points.name: subjunctive after seul, unique and superlatives
points.can_do_en: Can use the subjunctive after seul, unique, premier and dernier.
points.example: Il est le seul qui ait refusé cette offre.
points.example_en: He is the only one who refused this offer.

points.name: soit que ... soit que
points.can_do_en: Can list possible causes with soit que ... soit que and the subjunctive.
points.example: Soit qu'il soit fatigué, soit qu'il ait peur, il se tait.
points.example_en: Whether he is tired or afraid, he stays silent.

points.name: quelque, quel que, quelque ... que
points.can_do_en: Can express concession with quel que, quelque and si ... que.
points.example: Quelles que soient vos raisons, nous les respecterons.
points.example_en: Whatever your reasons, we will respect them.

points.name: en attendant que and de peur que
points.can_do_en: Can use en attendant que, de peur que and sans que with the subjunctive.
points.example: Nous resterons ici en attendant que la pluie cesse.
points.example_en: We will stay here until the rain stops.

points.name: subjunctive in independent clauses
points.can_do_en: Can use a stand-alone subjunctive for wishes, orders and concessions.
points.example: Que chacun fasse de son mieux ! Vive la liberté !
points.example_en: May everyone do their best! Long live freedom!

points.name: values of the pluperfect
points.can_do_en: Can use the pluperfect for background, regret, politeness and reported speech.
points.example: Je voulais vous dire que j'avais oublié de vous écrire.
points.example_en: I wanted to tell you that I had forgotten to write to you.

points.name: nuances of the conditional
points.can_do_en: Can use the conditional for politeness, hypothesis and reported rumour.
points.example: Pourriez-vous m'indiquer la direction ? Il y aurait un retard.
points.example_en: Could you show me the way? There would be a delay.

points.name: alternatives to si
points.can_do_en: Can express a condition with en cas de, sauf si, pour peu que and dans l'hypothèse où.
points.example: Dans l'hypothèse où il refuserait, nous chercherions un autre fournisseur.
points.example_en: If he were to refuse, we would look for another supplier.

points.name: passé simple in narrative
points.can_do_en: Can read the passé simple in novels, history and tales.
points.example: Il ouvrit la porte, entra et s'assit sans un mot.
points.example_en: He opened the door, came in and sat down without a word.

points.name: past anterior
points.can_do_en: Can recognise the passé antérieur after quand, dès que and aussitôt que.
points.example: Dès qu'il eut fini son discours, la salle applaudit.
points.example_en: As soon as he had finished his speech, the room applauded.

points.name: compound participle and absolute construction
points.can_do_en: Can use ayant fait and étant parti, and absolute clauses with a different subject.
points.example: Le soleil s'étant couché, nous avons rallumé le feu.
points.example_en: The sun having set, we relit the fire.

points.name: spelling of verbal adjective versus participle
points.can_do_en: Can tell fatigant and fatiguant, différent and différant apart.
points.example: Des résultats différant peu des précédents sont différents des prévisions.
points.example_en: Results differing little from earlier ones are different from the forecasts.

points.name: se voir and se faire plus infinitive
points.can_do_en: Can use se voir, se faire and se laisser to avoid heavy passives.
points.example: Elle s'est vu refuser le visa et s'est fait remarquer.
points.example_en: She was refused the visa and got noticed.

points.name: relative clauses with prepositions and lequel
points.can_do_en: Can build relatives after complex prepositions such as à travers lequel.
points.example: La raison pour laquelle il a démissionné reste obscure.
points.example_en: The reason for which he resigned remains unclear.

points.name: ce à quoi, ce sur quoi, tout ce qui
points.can_do_en: Can use ce à quoi, ce sur quoi and tout ce que for abstract ideas.
points.example: Tout ce que vous dites est exact, ce sur quoi nous sommes d'accord.
points.example_en: Everything you say is correct, which is something we agree on.

points.name: pseudo-cleft: ce qui ... c'est
points.can_do_en: Can stress with ce qui ... c'est and ce que ... c'est.
points.example: Ce qui m'importe, c'est que vous soyez sincère.
points.example_en: What matters to me is that you are sincere.

points.name: dislocation and resumptive pronouns
points.can_do_en: Can use left and right dislocation for focus in speech and writing.
points.example: Ce projet, nous y croyons ; les risques, nous les connaissons.
points.example_en: This project, we believe in it; the risks, we know them.

points.name: stylistic inversion
points.can_do_en: Can use subject inversion in relatives, subordinates and quotations.
points.example: Voici le livre qu'a écrit mon père.
points.example_en: Here is the book that my father wrote.

points.name: ne alone with certain verbs
points.can_do_en: Can recognise ne without pas with oser, cesser, pouvoir and savoir.
points.example: Je n'ose imaginer ce qu'il en pensera.
points.example_en: I dare not imagine what he will think of it.

points.name: restrictive ne ... que and ne ... guère
points.can_do_en: Can use ne ... que, ne ... guère and ne ... point in careful French.
points.example: Il ne reste que deux places, et je n'ai guère de temps.
points.example_en: Only two seats remain, and I have hardly any time.

points.name: adjectives that change meaning with position
points.can_do_en: Can choose the position of grand, pauvre, propre, ancien and cher.
points.example: Cet homme grand n'est pas un grand homme, mais mon ancien collègue l'est.
points.example_en: This tall man is not a great man, but my former colleague is.

points.name: omission of the article
points.can_do_en: Can omit the article in lists, proverbs, titles and with en plus a noun.
points.example: Il est devenu avocat, et il travaille sans relâche, par amour de son métier.
points.example_en: He became a lawyer, and he works tirelessly, out of love for his profession.

points.name: n'importe qui, quoi, où, quand, comment
points.can_do_en: Can use n'importe plus an interrogative for free choice.
points.example: N'importe qui peut participer, n'importe quand.
points.example_en: Anyone can take part, at any time.

points.name: quiconque, chacun, quelques-uns, certains
points.can_do_en: Can use quiconque, nul, aucun and autrui in careful writing.
points.example: Quiconque enfreint ce règlement sera sanctionné.
points.example_en: Whoever breaks this rule will be punished.

points.name: structuring an argument
points.can_do_en: Can organise an argument with d'abord, en outre, d'une part ... d'autre part, enfin.
points.example: D'une part, le coût baisse ; d'autre part, la qualité progresse.
points.example_en: On the one hand the cost falls; on the other, quality improves.

points.name: formal letters
points.can_do_en: Can write formal letters with set openings, requests and closings.
points.example: Madame, Monsieur, je vous prie de bien vouloir m'envoyer votre brochure.
points.example_en: Dear Sir or Madam, I would be grateful if you would send me your brochure.

points.name: common versus formal register
points.can_do_en: Can adapt vocabulary and structure between everyday and formal French.
points.example: Veuillez patienter ; nous reviendrons vers vous dans les meilleurs délais.
points.example_en: Please wait; we will get back to you as soon as possible.

points.name: euphony: l'on, -t-, liaison
points.can_do_en: Can use l'on, -t- and elided forms for easy pronunciation.
points.example: A-t-il compris ce que l'on attend de lui ?
points.example_en: Has he understood what is expected of him?

points.name: concession: quoique, malgré, en dépit de
points.can_do_en: Can contrast clauses with quoique, malgré que, en dépit de and tandis que.
points.example: En dépit de la fatigue, elle a terminé la course.
points.example_en: Despite her tiredness, she finished the race.

points.name: cause and manner with the gerund
points.can_do_en: Can express manner or cause with en plus the participle.
points.example: En lisant chaque soir, il a enrichi son vocabulaire.
points.example_en: By reading every evening, he enriched his vocabulary.

points.name: proportion: plus ... plus, d'autant plus que
points.can_do_en: Can express proportional change with plus ... plus and d'autant plus que.
points.example: Plus je travaille, plus je progresse, d'autant plus que le sujet me plaît.
points.example_en: The more I work, the more I progress, all the more because I like the subject.

points.name: reported speech with nuances
points.can_do_en: Can use annoncer, prétendre, soutenir, reconnaître with correct moods.
points.example: Il prétend avoir raison ; elle reconnaît qu'elle s'est trompée.
points.example_en: He claims he is right; she admits she was wrong.

points.name: imperfect and pluperfect subjunctive in literary style
points.can_do_en: Can read the imperfect and pluperfect subjunctive in classic prose.
points.example: Il eût fallu qu'il parlât plus tôt pour qu'on l'entendît.
points.example_en: He should have spoken sooner for people to hear him.

points.name: second form of the past conditional
points.can_do_en: Can recognise eût fait and fût venu replacing the past conditional.
points.example: Si j'eusse su, je fusse venu plus tôt.
points.example_en: Had I known, I would have come earlier.

points.name: inversion in hypothetical subordinates
points.can_do_en: Can read and use inversion forms such as fût-il, dût-il, eût-il.
points.example: Fût-il malade, il viendrait à la réunion.
points.example_en: Even if he were ill, he would come to the meeting.

points.name: subjunctive for hypothesis and concession
points.can_do_en: Can use que plus subjunctive and sans doute que to hypothesise.
points.example: Qu'il pleuve ou qu'il vente, nous partirons.
points.example_en: Whether it rains or blows, we will leave.

points.name: passé simple and imparfait in narration
points.can_do_en: Can interlace passé simple and imparfait for foreground and background.
points.example: Il pleuvait quand elle sortit ; elle s'arrêta et regarda le ciel.
points.example_en: It was raining when she went out; she stopped and looked at the sky.

points.name: historical present and narrative present
points.can_do_en: Can use the historical present for vivid narration.
points.example: En 1789, le peuple prend la Bastille et change l'histoire.
points.example_en: In 1789, the people take the Bastille and change history.

points.name: modal values of the future
points.can_do_en: Can use the future for conjecture, command and politeness.
points.example: Vous voudrez bien m'excuser ; ce sera sans doute un oubli.
points.example_en: Please excuse me; it will probably be an oversight.

points.name: stylistic imperfect
points.can_do_en: Can use the imperfect for hypothetical, narrative and polite effects.
points.example: Une minute de plus, et le train partait sans nous.
points.example_en: One more minute and the train would have left without us.

points.name: infinitive of narration and exclamation
points.can_do_en: Can recognise the narrative infinitive and the exclamative infinitive.
points.example: Et lui de s'indigner, et nous de rire.
points.example_en: And he gets indignant, and we laugh.

points.name: apposition and detached adjectives
points.can_do_en: Can use detached adjectives and appositions to compress information.
points.example: Épuisée, la lauréate a pourtant remercié le public avec un grand sourire.
points.example_en: Exhausted, the winner nevertheless thanked the audience with a big smile.

points.name: nominal sentences
points.can_do_en: Can write verbless sentences for rhythm and emphasis.
points.example: Un silence. Puis, au loin, le bruit d'une porte qui claque.
points.example_en: A silence. Then, far off, the sound of a door slamming.

points.name: rhetorical figures: parallelism and chiasmus
points.can_do_en: Can build parallel and mirrored structures for rhetoric.
points.example: Il faut manger pour vivre, et non vivre pour manger.
points.example_en: One must eat to live, not live to eat.

points.name: concession with si ... que and tout ... que
points.can_do_en: Can use si habile qu'il soit and tout savant qu'il est.
points.example: Si habile qu'il soit, il ne peut tout prévoir.
points.example_en: However skilful he is, he cannot foresee everything.

points.name: participial clauses with a different subject
points.can_do_en: Can use clauses like cela dit, ce point réglé, les élections passées.
points.example: Ce point réglé, la séance a été levée.
points.example_en: That point settled, the meeting was closed.

points.name: demonstratives celui-ci/celui-là and ceux
points.can_do_en: Can use celui, celle, ceux with de, qui, que and the pair ci/là.
points.example: Ceux qui travaillent régulièrement réussissent mieux que ceux qui révisent la veille.
points.example_en: Those who work regularly do better than those who revise the night before.

points.name: neutral le as attribute
points.can_do_en: Can use invariable le to replace an adjective or clause.
points.example: Elle est heureuse et le restera, je le crois.
points.example_en: She is happy and will remain so, I believe.

points.name: definite article with parts of the body
points.can_do_en: Can use the article instead of possessives with body parts.
points.example: Elle s'est lavé les mains et il s'est cassé la jambe.
points.example_en: She washed her hands and he broke his leg.

points.name: participle agreement with faire, laisser and impersonal verbs
points.can_do_en: Can handle invariable fait, laissé and impersonal participles.
points.example: Les fortes pluies qu'il a fait tomber ont inondé la vallée. Les efforts qu'il a fallu ont été considérables.
points.example_en: The heavy rain it brought flooded the valley. The effort that was needed was considerable.

points.name: participle with coûter, valoir, courir
points.can_do_en: Can decide on agreement with coûté, vécu, pesé, couru.
points.example: Je n'oublierai jamais les efforts que ce projet m'a coûtés.
points.example_en: I will never forget the effort this project cost me.

points.name: agreement of colour and compound adjectives
points.can_do_en: Can agree compound and colour adjectives and demi, nu, feu.
points.example: Elle porte des chaussures bleu marine et une robe vert pomme.
points.example_en: She is wearing navy blue shoes and an apple-green dress.

points.name: agreement with collective subjects
points.can_do_en: Can agree the verb after une foule de, la plupart, plus d'un.
points.example: La plupart des invités sont partis tôt, mais une foule de curieux attendait encore.
points.example_en: Most guests left early, but a crowd of onlookers was still waiting.

points.name: quelque, quel que and quelques
points.can_do_en: Can spell quelque, quelques, quel que and quelque que correctly.
points.example: Quelques erreurs, quelle que soit leur gravité, subsistent.
points.example_en: A few errors, whatever their seriousness, remain.

points.name: literary register and lexical precision
points.can_do_en: Can choose precise and elevated words for essays and speeches.
points.example: Cette thèse, d'ailleurs fort contestée, mérite néanmoins d'être examinée.
points.example_en: This thesis, which is also much disputed, nonetheless deserves to be examined.

points.name: irony, understatement and rhetorical effects
points.can_do_en: Can read and produce litote, irony and euphemism.
points.example: Ce n'est pas mal du tout, dit-elle avec un sourire.
points.example_en: It is not bad at all, she said with a smile.

points.name: cohesion with anaphora and nominal resumption
points.can_do_en: Can link sentences with anaphoric nouns such as ce phénomène, cette mesure.
points.example: Le gouvernement a annoncé une réforme ; cette mesure divise l'opinion.
points.example_en: The government announced a reform; this measure divides opinion.

points.name: formal prepositional phrases
points.can_do_en: Can use au regard de, eu égard à, en vertu de, quant à.
points.example: Eu égard à votre situation, nous accordons un délai.
points.example_en: Having regard to your situation, we grant an extension.

points.name: de instead of des before plural adjectives
points.can_do_en: Can choose de or des before a plural adjective and noun.
points.example: Il y a de beaux jardins, mais aussi des jardins publics fermés.
points.example_en: There are beautiful gardens, but also closed public gardens.

points.name: on and its agreement
points.can_do_en: Can use on for we, people, someone and agree the adjective.
points.example: On est restées amies, ma sœur et moi.
points.example_en: We remained friends, my sister and I.

points.name: stressed pronouns for emphasis and comparison
points.can_do_en: Can use moi, lui, soi and the aussi/non plus patterns.
points.example: Lui, il a refusé ; moi non plus, je n'ai pas accepté.
points.example_en: He refused; I did not accept either.

points.name: complex and formal questions
points.can_do_en: Can ask formal questions with inversion and long subjects.
points.example: Pourquoi le directeur a-t-il refusé cette demande ?
points.example_en: Why did the director refuse this request?

points.name: free indirect speech
points.can_do_en: Can read free indirect style mixing narration and thought.
points.example: Elle regarda la lettre. Comment pourrait-il oublier ?
points.example_en: She looked at the letter. How could he forget?
